headline: Customer appeal of a sewer credit for 414 South Elm Street and approval of the Director's Report for August 2026.
summary: The commission will discuss a customer appeal for a sewer credit at 414 South Elm Street, review the Director's Report for August 2026, and discuss electric rate comparisons. Committee reports and correspondence will also be reviewed.
